## Problem 5

### Setup

```{r}
# regression function
beta <- function(x) {
  c(1, x) # SLR
}

# get information matrix
info_matrix <- function(points, weights, beta_func) {
  # points: vector of support points like c(1, 1)
  # weights: vector of weights like c(0.3, 0.7) that sums to 1
  k <- length(beta_func(points[1]))  # should be 2 for SLR
  M <- matrix(0, k, k) # initialize k by k matrix of 0
  # loop through to add contribution of each support point
  for(i in 1:length(points)) {
    f <- beta_func(points[i])
    M <- M + weights[i] * outer(f, f)
  } 
  # add small term for stability
  M <- M + 1e-6 * diag(k)
  return(M)
}

# A-optimality criterion 
a_criterion <- function(points, weights, beta_func) {
  M <- info_matrix(points, weights, beta_func) # apply previous function to inputs
  invM <- solve(M) # find inverse
  return(sum(diag(invM)))  # trace
}
```

### PSO on 2 points

```{r}
# wrapper function to apply a_criterion on single vector containing both points and weights (for 2 point design)
# needed to use psoptim 
pso_2pt <- function(params){
  # params[1] = first point
  # params[2] = second point  
  # params[3] = weight at first point (weight at second is 1-params[3])
  points <- c(params[1], params[2])
  weights <- c(params[3], 1- params[3])
  return(a_criterion(points, weights, beta))
}

# [-1,1]
set.seed(789)
result_1 <- psoptim(
  par = c(0, 0.5, 0.5),  # start with points at 0 and 0.5, equal weight
  fn = pso_2pt,
  lower = c(-1, -1, 0.01),
  upper = c(1, 1, 0.99),
  control = list(maxit = 500, trace = FALSE, s = 50)
)

# Results
cat("[-1, 1] Results:\n")
cat("Optimal design points: x1 =", round(result_1$par[1], 4), 
    ", x2 =", round(result_1$par[2], 4), "\n")
cat("Optimal weight at x1: w =", round(result_1$par[3], 4), "\n")
cat("Optimal weight at x2:", round(1 - result_1$par[3], 4), "\n")

# [3,49]
set.seed(789)
result_3_49 <- psoptim(
  par = c(20, 30, 0.1),  # start with points at 0 and 0.5, equal weight
  fn = pso_2pt,
  lower = c(3, 3, 0.01),
  upper = c(49, 49, 0.99),
  control = list(maxit = 500, trace = FALSE, s = 50)
)

# Results
cat("[3, 49] Results:\n")
cat("Optimal design points: x1 =", round(result_3_49$par[1], 4), 
    ", x2 =", round(result_3_49$par[2], 4), "\n")
cat("Optimal weight at x1: w =", round(result_3_49$par[3], 4), "\n")
cat("Optimal weight at x2:", round(1 - result_3_49$par[3], 4), "\n")
```

### Confirm optimal design with plot

```{r}
# sensitivity function for A-optimality
sensitivity <- function(x, points, weights, beta_func) {
  M <- info_matrix(points, weights, beta_func)
  invM <- solve(M)
  f_x <- beta_func(x)
  as.numeric(t(f_x) %*% invM %*% invM %*% f_x) - sum(diag(invM))
}

# Plot function
plot_sensitivity <- function(pso_result, beta_func, interval) {
  # Extract design
  x1 <- pso_result$par[1]
  x2 <- pso_result$par[2]
  w <- pso_result$par[3]
  points <- c(x1, x2)
  weights <- c(w, 1 - w)
  
  # Compute sensitivity across interval
  x_grid <- seq(interval[1], interval[2], length.out = 500)
  sens_vals <- sapply(x_grid, function(x) {
    sensitivity(x, points, weights, beta_func)
  })
  
  # Sensitivity at support points
  sens_at_points <- sapply(points, function(x) {
    sensitivity(x, points, weights, beta_func)
  })
  
  # Plot
  plot(x_grid, sens_vals, type = "l", 
       xlab = "x", 
       ylab = expression(phi(x, xi)),
       lwd = 2)
  abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 1.5)
  points(points, sens_at_points, col = "blue", pch = 16, cex = 1.2)
  legend("bottomright", 
         legend = c("Sensitivity", "Zero", "Support points"),
         col = c("black", "red", "blue"), 
         lty = c(1, 2, NA), 
         pch = c(NA, NA, 16),
         lwd = c(2, 1.5, NA))
}

# Plot both designs
plot_sensitivity(result_1, beta, c(-1, 1))

plot_sensitivity(result_3_49, beta, c(3, 49))
```
